newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh to set up village courts.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh to set up village courts.

text.p: Bangladesh Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina said on Tuesday her government is working on a plan to set up courts at rural level to settle minor disputes speedily and at lesser expense.
"Grameen (village) courts which we are planning will play a pivotal role to settle disputes in rural areas," she told parliament.
Hasina said each of the country's 460 rural administrative units would have at least one court.
"The programme is designed to ensure justice at door steps of common people," she said without elaborating.
The prime minister said a bill on the proposed court would be sent to parliament "at an appropriate time" and that the government would invite public opinion on the plan and consult judicial experts.
